rappel_detail.anchor: natural: a sling on a horn or block, not bolts
rappel_detail.station: Near the true summit, above the most exposed part of the Class 3-4 ledge downclimb.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional single rappel on one 50 m rope, or a 60 m rope doubled, to get below the crux onto easier ground; plenty of parties downclimb the whole way. Then continue to the col between the east and west summits.

set.rappels: 1 optional rappel on a 50 m rope from a natural anchor near the summit; many parties downclimb instead
